query:
UPDATE schematic SET category = ?, width = ?, orientation = ?,
            encoding = ?, latency = ?, synchronized = ?, design = ?,
            carry_in = ?, carry_out = ?, built_on = ?,
            description = ?, given_name = ?,
            edited_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')
         WHERE id = ?
